en.text:
Successive Hits within 0.2 seconds of each grant a ramping Damage Buff after scoring 12.5% of the Magazine Capacity as hits. Missing deactivates the buff.

Stacks displayed on-screen are only visual aides, the buff <link ramps up with each shot [https://url.d2clarity.com/PvETargetLock] /> once active. Reaches maximum strength at 5 Stacks.

% of the Magazine Capacity as Hits required for each Visual Stack: 12.5%|35.5%|54.5%|74.5%|110.33%

Damage Buff ramps up from #e<pve ${16.73*#d}% /> <pvp [${10.46*#f}%] /> to #e<pve ${40*#d}% /> <pvp [${25*#f}%] /> upon reaching maximum strength.


Assuming no missed shots, it provides roughly a #e<pve ${25*#d}% /> <pvp [${15.85*#f}%] /> <link Damage Buff on average [https://url.d2clarity.com/PvETargetLock] /> after firing 100% of the Magazine Capacity.
